description: Read one perfume by its handle: name, house, description, top, heart and base notes, and every size (3, 10 and 30 ml) with the price, the struck regular price, price per ml and whether it is in stock, exactly as the product page shows them, plus the full bottle (listed out of stock) and the product URL.
